metadata.description: Iterative refinement of retention metrics with filter corrections

turns.content: Show me user retention metrics for Q4 2024.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show retention metrics for Oct-Dec 2024

turns.content: Only include users who have logged in at least once.

annotations.establishesFilter: Users with at least one login
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter to users with login events

turns.content: Add daily active users (DAU) and weekly active users (WAU) columns.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should add DAU/WAU calculations

turns.content: For active user calculations, always use event.created_at as the timestamp.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should confirm and use created_at

turns.content: Show me DAU/MAU ratio by week.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate weekly DAU/MAU ratio

turns.content: Exclude weekends from the DAU calculation — we're a B2B product.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter to weekdays only

turns.content: Apply all our filters and show me the retention by account tier.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply: >= 1 login, use created_at, exclude weekends

turns.content: What filters are currently applied?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list all active filters

turns.content: Show me the user engagement score distribution.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze engagement score distribution

turns.content: Which accounts have the highest engagement scores?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should rank accounts by engagement

turns.content: When I say engagement, I mean the sum of all feature_usage.usage_count for the user.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use usage_count sum for engagement

turns.content: Show me engagement by user role.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze engagement by user role

turns.content: Which features are most used by retained users?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show feature usage for retained users

turns.content: Remember the DAU/MAU ratio? Show me that by account tier.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show DAU/MAU by plan tier

turns.content: Create a chart showing DAU trend over Q4.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create DAU trend visualization

turns.content: What was the login filter we established?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall >= 1 login filter

turns.content: Correct. Show me the breakdown by user status.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze by user status

turns.content: Show me all filters currently active.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list all filters

turns.content: Apply everything and show me top 10 users by engagement.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show top users with all filters

turns.content: What's the average engagement per user?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate average engagement

turns.content: Show me engagement distribution by account size.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze engagement by account user count

turns.content: Create a final summary with all corrections applied.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should provide comprehensive summary

turns.content: Create a chart of engagement by tier.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create tier engagement visualization

turns.content: What was the total DAU for December?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall December DAU figure

turns.content: Show me the final user count by activity level.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show user distribution by activity

turns.content: Create a final dashboard visualization.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create summary dashboard

turns.content: What filters are currently active?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list all active filters

turns.content: Show me retention rate by industry with all filters.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show retention by industry

turns.content: Create a final chart showing retention trends.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create retention trend visualization

turns.content: Thank you. We've analyzed Q4 2024 retention showing that Enterprise tier has the highest DAU/MAU ratio, with Admin roles showing strongest engagement.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should acknowledge findings

persistedCorrections.correctionText: Only users with at least one login
persistedCorrections.description: Filter to users with login events
